response.justification: Bogdan has extensive fullstack experience with a strong focus on TypeScript, React, and Node.js, aligning well with the role's requirements. His background includes scalable systems, databases (PostgreSQL is implied via relational experience), and cloud platforms (AWS). While his recent work leans toward AI infrastructure and D language, his historical expertise in JavaScript ecosystems and pragmatic architecture suggests adaptability to the renewable energy platform's needs.

Experience with scalable systems, REST APIs, and relational databases (MongoDB, SQL)
Proven ability to integrate diverse tools (CRM, document management) and optimize workflows
concerns: Recent focus on AI/ML (LLM integration) may not directly align with core stack requirements
Limited explicit PostgreSQL experience (though SQL is listed; PostgreSQL is preferred)
